title: Yellow Smoky Mexican Vanilla Churros
description: Smoky and velvety Mexican dessert featuring vanilla pod and plant-based friendly ingredients, served in a claypot. This kid-friendly dish is perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine non-dairy milk, granulated sugar, and smoked paprika, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Add the split vanilla pod to the saucepan and remove from heat, letting it steep for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the steeped non-dairy milk mixture to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat canola oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Pipe the dough through a star tip into the hot oil, cutting into 4-inch pieces.
Fry the churros for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the churros on paper towels and dust with cinnamon sugar.
Serve the churros in a claypot, flambeing with a small amount of non-dairy rum or other plant-based liquor, if desired.
